reader: Claude third reader (assigned by the Claude coordinator)
method: Original paper and scheme renders named in third-reader-input.json read for every item. Rules: PLAN R7/R9, CARD-STANDARD sections 5 and 9, BRIEF rule 5, standard-model/stage1/READING.md rules 4 and 6 (a printed choice spanning more than two headings takes the two covering most, flagged CHOICE SPANS; Case Study and Audio Visual are format headings, used only where the ask tests the case or recording itself). Splitting rule applied across all LCVP packets: a separately printed instruction, or an item the paper itself names, that the scheme marks separately is its own card; a single 'state and explain N' instruction whose (1+1) sits inside each answer point stays one card.

items.reason: Paper p24 Q4(c), under 'Learning about businesses operating in your local area', asks how a business owner or manager ensures targets are met and scheme p12 (physical p14) pays 4 @ 2m (1+1) for running the business (planning, staffing, reviewing targets, incentives, customer service, marketing), filed with live 2023 Q4(a)/(d) business-management asks.

Paper p26 Q5, 'you are required to organise a class enterprise activity', (a) asks two methods of generating ideas for a class enterprise and scheme p13 (physical p15) pays 2 @ 1m for brainstorming, market research and similar first steps of that activity.

Paper p7 Q8 asks advice for someone setting up a craft business in Ireland and scheme p3 (physical p5) pays 3 @ 2m (1+1) for start-up advice (research, business skills and supports, promotion, finance, business plan, location), which is setting up a local business, as 2011 B3(ii) is settled.

Paper p9 Q1 is one printed 'explain three of the following' choice over four terms (smartphones, plan of action, redundancy package, CV) that scheme p4 (physical p6) marks alike at 3 @ 2m (1+1), so it stays one card (R7); the terms test content, not the case, so under READING rules 4 and 6 it takes the two content headings covering most options, Enterprise Skills (smartphones/ICT, plan of action) and Introduction to Working Life (redundancy), flagged CHOICE SPANS with Job Seeking Skills (CV).
items.note: The live 2015-2026 Section B 'explain three of the following terms' cards (2015, 2018, 2020, 2021 Q1) sit under Case Study by evidence default (decision code xa, never read); by the same rule they would move to content headings. BRIEF rule 5 would also permit per-option cards since the options sit under different topics; that is a coordinator call for all term-choice cards at once.

items.reason: Paper p28 Q5(d) is one instruction, 'State and explain three types of advertising', and scheme p14 (physical p16) pays 3 @ 2m (1+1) per type with each model printing the type and its explanation together and no mark for the product named, so the (1+1) is the inside of each answer point, not two separately answered tasks (R7); keep one six-mark card, with the scoped no-answer notice for models 3, 7 and 8 that print a type without an explanation.
